verdict.rationale: Postmark publishes a public pricing page and a machine-readable pricing.txt. These list add-on prices without a sales call: DMARC monitoring at $14/month per domain and custom activity retention at $5/month on Pro or higher. Dedicated IPs are listed as available at 300,000+ emails per month, but no price is shown, and the evidence names plan tiers only through feature differences such as 5 versus unlimited custom sending domains. Missing for 10: published per-volume tier prices, overage rates, a dedicated IP price, any email validation add-on or its price, and independent confirmation that pricing needs no sales contact.
